```{=html}
<section id="cimehr" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="cimehr">CIMEHR</h2>
<p><strong>Gaussian Clinically Informative Visiting and Observation Processes in EHR Data</strong></p>
<p>An R package for analyzing longitudinal biomarkers from electronic health records when the visit and observation processes are themselves informative. CIMEHR fits joint models with shared random effects that link a patient’s latent health trajectory to when they are seen and what gets measured, yielding valid inference for biomarker trajectories under informative visiting and observation.</p>
<section id="features" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="features">Features</h3>
<ul>
<li>Joint modeling of the biomarker, visit, and observation processes</li>
<li>Shared random effects linking latent health to visiting and measurement</li>
<li>Corrects bias from informative visit and observation mechanisms</li>
<li>Built for multi-cohort EHR data (biobanks and health-system records)</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="installation" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="installation">Installation</h3>
```

```r
remotes::install_github("cyang728/CIMEHR")
```

```{=html}

<section id="demodesign" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="demodesign">DEMOdesign</h2>
<p><strong>Dose Exploration, Monitoring, and Optimization Using Biological and Clinical Outcomes</strong></p>
<p>An R package implementing the DEMO design—a Bayesian adaptive Phase I/II trial framework tailored for oncology dose-finding, particularly for immunotherapies and targeted therapies. It selects an Optimal Therapeutic Dose (OTD) that maximizes Restricted Mean Survival Time (RMST) while ensuring safety, biological activity, and clinical efficacy across three stages.</p>
<section id="features-1" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="features-1">Features</h3>
<ul>
<li>Three-stage Bayesian adaptive design (Exploration, Monitoring, Optimization)</li>
<li>Integrates biomarker, toxicity, response, and survival endpoints</li>
<li>BOIN-based exploration with biomarker and toxicity screening</li>
<li>RMST-based dose optimization</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="installation-1" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="installation-1">Installation</h3>
```

```r
remotes::install_github("cyang728/DEMOdesign")
```

```{=html}

<section id="bar12" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="bar12">BAR12</h2>
<p><strong>Bayesian Autoregressive Phase 1-2 Design for Cell Therapy Trials with Manufacturing Changes</strong></p>
<p>An R package implementing the BAR12 design for seamless dose-finding in early-phase cell therapy trials that incorporate mid-trial manufacturing modifications—or <em>tweaks</em>—such as changes to cell culture duration, cytokine cocktails, or donor criteria. BAR12 uses a Bayesian autoregressive model with spike-and-slab priors to distinguish between pre- and post-tweak outcome distributions, allowing dynamic borrowing of information while accounting for possible shifts.</p>
<section id="features-2" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="features-2">Features</h3>
<ul>
<li>Handles mid-trial manufacturing process changes</li>
<li>Bayesian autoregressive model with spike-and-slab priors</li>
<li>Dynamic information borrowing across trial stages</li>
<li>Stan-based posterior computation</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="installation-2" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="installation-2">Installation</h3>
```

```r
remotes::install_github("cyang728/BAR12")
```

```{=html}
<section id="mcpmodx" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="mcpmodx">MCPModX</h2>
<p><strong>Covariate-Adjusted MCP-Mod for Dose-Response Analysis</strong></p>
<p>An R package that incorporates covariate adjustment to enhance the robustness and precision of dose-response analyses. The approach leverages g-computation to address non-collapsibility and employs model-assisted estimation to ensure valid inferences, even in the presence of model misspecification.</p>
<section id="features-3" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="features-3">Features</h3>
<ul>
<li>Covariate adjustment in MCP-Mod framework</li>
<li>G-computation for non-collapsible endpoints</li>
<li>Support for binary endpoints with prognostic scores</li>
<li>Model-assisted estimation for robust inference</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="installation-3" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="installation-3">Installation</h3>
```

```r
remotes::install_github("cyang728/MCPModX")
```
